title: KESSER 4-Piece Hard-Shell Luggage Set (S-M-L-XL) with TSA Lock
short_description: Luggage set with 4 hard-shell trolleys in sizes S, M, L and XL, with 4 wheels, a telescopic handle and a TSA combination lock.
long_description: The KESSER luggage set consists of 4 hard-shell trolleys in sizes S, M, L and XL. The shells are made of ABS and are stackable. Each case rolls on 4 wheels and has a telescopic handle and a carry handle. The TSA combination lock secures the contents. A luggage tag, a luggage scale and instructions are also included.
